FACT the file contains one theorem: for `P n = ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 n, i * X^(i-1)` over ℂ, `IsCoprime (P j) (P k)` for positive `j ≠ k`.

FACT `P n` has the closed form `(x-1)^2 · P n = n x^(n+1) - (n+1) x^n + 1`.

FACT a common root `z` of `P j` and `P k` satisfies `z ≠ 0`, `z ≠ 1`, and `z^n ((n+1) - n z) = 1` for `n ∈ {j, k}`.

INFER `|z| = 1` is impossible <- `|(n+1) - n z| ≥ 1` with equality only at `z = 1`.

INFER `|z| < 1` is impossible <- `h(r) = r^n (n+1 - n r)` is strictly increasing on `[0,1]` with `h(1) = 1`.

HYP `|z| > 1` is impossible for a common root of `P j` and `P k` with `j ≠ k`.

CHECK derive a contradiction in the case `|z| > 1` using both equations `z^j((j+1) - j z) = 1` and `z^k((k+1) - k z) = 1`.

RESULT the `|z| > 1` case has no argument yet; the triangle-inequality bounds used for `|z| ≤ 1` do not apply there.

RESULT formalizing this in Lean also needs the Mathlib bridge "IsCoprime over ℂ ⇔ no common root", which I have not located and cannot test without the Mathlib sources.

RESULT the proof is incomplete and the file has not been edited or compiled.

I give up.
